title: Primary concentric spheres and capped cylinders (axisymmetric), potentiostatic and galvanostatic: per-level agreement with axi::ElectroProblem (eps -> kappa)
physics: Laplace for phi in the electrolyte, primary electrodes (Dirichlet or floating conductor), insulating walls; the electrostatic analogue solved by the existing ElectroProblem

parameters.kappa_note: kappa != 1 so that a conductivity defect is visible
parameters.electrode_note: the cathode wall is at phi_s - E_eq = +0.02 V, not 0, so that a cathode forced to 0 V is visible; positive, so that phi > 0 everywhere and int phi dV has no cancellation (a -0.02 V wall made the galv sphere functional nearly cancel: 4.6e-12 spread)

variants.pot: both electrodes potentiostatic primary: phi = 0.2 V on the inner, +0.02 V on the outer electrode
variants.galv: anode galvanostatic primary (floating conductor, 3D total 0.03 A), cathode potentiostatic primary

sectors.axi_sph: meridian half annulus, theta in [0, pi] from +z (3D total)
sectors.axi_cyl: rectangle r1 < r < r2, 0 < z < 0.01 m, insulating caps (3D total)

quantities.I_anode: reaction current of the anode (3D total, A): chem = 2 pi x sum of the full weak-form residual (without the electrode's own term) over the anode dofs; ElectroProblem = Q_0 = 2 pi sum_(tied dofs) (K phi). Discretization: run.parameters.discretization (domain rule, P2 edge nodes)
quantities.I_cathode: reaction current of the cathode (3D total, A, negative), as I_anode. A discrete-conservation identity: equals -I_anode (pot) or -I_galv (galv) to round-off for any discretization
quantities.Iflux_anode: strong-flux anode current int kappa grad phi_h. n_out dA (one-sided element gradients) on the Gauss-Legendre facet rule with k + 4 points (degree 2k + 6, ElectroProblem's Gauss-law rule); ElectroProblem = Q_gauss_0. Discretization: run.parameters.discretization
quantities.phi_mean: int phi_h dV = 2 pi int phi_h r dA on the domain rule of run.parameters.discretization (MFEM 4.10 degree 2k + 4: 12 / 16 points) (V m^3)
quantities.phi_s_anode: metal potential of the floating (galvanostatic primary) anode (V); ElectroProblem: V_0 + E_eq,anode. Discretization: run.parameters.discretization

discretization.domain_rule: the stiffness and int phi dV use MFEM 4.10 IntRules.Get(Geometry::TRIANGLE, 2k + 4): 12 points (P1, degree 6) and 16 points (P2, degree 8), the rule of ElectroProblem's axi::Space; the exact points and weights on the reference triangle (x, y, w) are in domain_rule_points (copied from the generator output). On P1 and on the straight P2 cylinder every integrand is a polynomial of degree <= 3, so any rule of degree >= 3 gives the same values; on the CURVED P2 sphere the integrand is rational and the per-level values depend on the point set: another degree-8 rule moves N = 2 by up to 2.5e-8 and N = 4 by 2.1e-10, a converged rule by 3.8e-8 and 3.8e-10. An implementation (or MFEM version) with another rule FAILs the axi_sph_p2 points-per-element check and needs regenerated reference values.
discretization.facet_rule: the strong-flux current uses Gauss-Legendre with k + 4 points (degree 2k + 6) on each facet's own (isoparametric) parametrization: ElectroProblem's Gauss-law rule
discretization.p2_edge_nodes: axi_sph_p2: EVERY P2 edge node, interior edges included, at the polar map of the parametric (s, t) midpoint of its edge (so every node lies on a circle rho = r1 + i (r2 - r1)/(2N)); curving only the electrode arcs is a different discrete problem (moves the values by 3.7e-2 at N = 2... 1.7e-4 at N = 32). axi_cyl_p2: the map is affine, all nodes straight.
discretization.split_diagonal: every square of the structured (s, t) grid split along (i, j)-(i+1, j+1) into [(i,j),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1)] and [(i,j),(i+1,j+1),(i,j+1)] (checked by the connectivity hash)
discretization.certificates: the runner reports the domain quadrature points per element at the assembly degree (12 / 16; checked on axi_sph_p2, where the point set changes the discrete problem) and, on axi_sph_p2, the largest distance of a P2 node from its circle rho = r1 + i (r2 - r1)/(2N) (round-off for the fixed rule; ~1e-6 m for straight interior edges): acceptance.checks

axi_sph_p1.construction: polar map of a structured (s, t) grid: Nr = N, Ntheta = 2N (planar), 4N (axi_sph); axi_cyl: rect(N, N); P2: isoparametric nodes by the exact map

axi_sph_p2.construction: polar map of a structured (s, t) grid: Nr = N, Ntheta = 2N (planar), 4N (axi_sph); axi_cyl: rect(N, N); P2: isoparametric nodes by the exact map

axi_cyl_p1.construction: polar map of a structured (s, t) grid: Nr = N, Ntheta = 2N (planar), 4N (axi_sph); axi_cyl: rect(N, N); P2: isoparametric nodes by the exact map

axi_cyl_p2.construction: polar map of a structured (s, t) grid: Nr = N, Ntheta = 2N (planar), 4N (axi_sph); axi_cyl: rect(N, N); P2: isoparametric nodes by the exact map

newton.criterion: iterate TO STAGNATION: stop once relres <= stag and an iteration did not halve it (or relres is exactly 0); at most max_iter iterations; no early exit at a tolerance; converged = final relres <= the solver gate
newton.relres: max(field, constraint): field = |r_u|_2 / (|P^T |K| |phi||_2 + |P^T (|F_v| + |F_b|)|_2 + |P^T b_abs|_2), r_u the residual of the free (non-Dirichlet) dofs, P the elimination map, K the stiffness, F_v/F_b the volume/insulator loads, b_abs = int (sum_j |i_j| + |g|) v over the kinetic electrodes; constraint = max over galvanostatic electrodes |I_k,h - I_k| / |I_k| (bordered rows, per radian in axisymmetry: the 3D total divided by 2 pi)
newton.limiter: if max |d eta| over the kinetic electrodes' quadrature points exceeds 10 RT/F, the whole step is scaled to 10 RT/F and accepted without line search
newton.line_search: full Newton steps: halving down to 1/64 until |r| < (1 - 1e-4 t)|r_0|
newton.clamp: exponent arguments clipped at |200|; a clamp active at the final iterate = not converged
newton.initial: phi = 0; phi_s as given; galvanostatic phi_s initial as stated per case
